description: The table presents the prediction performance, measured as mean Average Precision (mAP) at different Intersection over Union (IoU) thresholds, of various object detection networks on the DocLayNet test set. Key columns include "human," which lists performance metrics for human annotations, and several models (MRCNN, FRCNN, YOLO), each with different configurations represented by their backbone networks (e.g., ResNet-50, ResNet-101). Notably, the MRCNN R101 achieved the highest performance in most categories, while the YOLO v5x6 model demonstrated competitive results, particularly in specific object classes. Main insights suggest that architecture sophistication and backbone choice significantly impact detection performance, with MRCNN models generally outperforming their FRCNN counterparts across the board.
